title: Excellent Experience
text: This was a great experience. Our tour guide was Anja, a local. Although involved a bit of a drive we did enjoyed it very much. Anja has a wealth of knowledge and experience. We highly recommend this tour.
author: Rafael_M

title: An interesting day
text: wasn't overly impressed by the destinations but the tour guide Anya was awesome and made the day allot of fun, The tour ran an extra hour longer then it was supposed too and she didn't rush us because of it. She also took us to a great Tappas resturaunt for lunch. Anya rocked the day!
author: gary_g

title: The White villages.
text: Aña was a wonderful driver and guide to the white villages. It was so interesting learning about the history and customs of the villages. We were fortunate that there was a Middle Ages festival going on in the first village we visited. There was a lot of walking uphill. One passenger waited in the village when he felt it was too much for him which worked out great.  I highly recommend doing this tour.
author: Marie_P

title: Ronda at its Best
text: Meeting Anja you feel that it will be a delightful day. We loved her enthusiasm and easy going manner. She made this tour a memorable experienced. Thank you Anja ❤️. Mario & Debbie
author: Mario_T

title: On the way we stopped for...
text: On the way we stopped for a typical breakfast of molletes (special rolls), tomato, olive oil and salt and continued on to Ronda and other villages. We drove through many hills of olive groves and learned about other local crops. The village streets were quaint and had many twists and turns. Our guide Anja was very knowledgeable and attentive. She took us to a local restaurant in one of the villages and helped us order tapas that were very delicious. The last village was built into the side of a mountain. It was a wonderful tour and I highly recommend her as a guide.
author: Melissa_L

title: Do not miss this fascinating trip!
text: This is a full day of fascinating places. A fair bit of walking in the sun, but the views are absolutely worth the little bit of effort. Our guide Anja was lovely - relaxed, friendly and knowledgable, she ensured that everyone was engaged and made sure of great photo opportunities. A really great way to spend the day and get some historical context of three amazing places. On the way back, Anja drove us through some spectacular scenery. An experience worth every penny!
author: Paul_H

title: Great trip and Brunch
text: We travelled with six others in a minibus - an ideal size for a personal touch yet benefitting from the savings and the caneraderie of a small group. We represented four different nationalities.  It's a long day and currently a little longer because some of the roads are bring repaired after floodwater this winter. Anja was always very informative and marshalled us very well. She was a mine of information about the landscape and the white villages. title: Today was an incredible...
text: Today was an incredible day! Anja is an incredible tour guide! So friendly, positive, patient and informative! Learned so much about the Zahara, Rhonda and Sentinel de Bodegas. Perfect day from beginning to end!
author: Stacy_S

title: The best tour of our holiday!  Explore the White Villages with Anja
text: What a fabulous day!  This tour of the White Villages with Anja was like meeting up with a friend of a friend who couldn't wait to share all the secrets of the area.  The breakfast was a great start to the day and it got better with fantastic scenery and exploring each village.  The restaurant she recommended for lunch was excellent where we got to try different tapas and were made to feel like locals!  Anja offers a unique and exceptional experience.
author: Linda_H

title: An excellent way to see smaller towns you might not otherwise go to!
text:
Anja was an amazing guide, and having a full day planned by her was such a great addition to my time in Sevilla. Getting out of the city and exploring the smaller towns gave me a completely different perspective on Andalusia. Anja knows so much about the region’s history and took us to some incredible viewpoints overlooking the villages and landmarks.
